reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1365 c, book 16, باب فَضِيلَةِ إِعْتَاقِهِ أَمَتَهُ ثُمَّ يَتَزَوَّجُهَا ‏
title: باب فَضِيلَةِ إِعْتَاقِهِ أَمَتَهُ ثُمَّ يَتَزَوَّجُهَا ‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ عُلَيَّةَ - عَنْ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم غَزَا خَيْبَرَ قَالَ فَصَلَّيْنَا عِنْدَهَا صَلاَةَ الْغَدَاةِ بِغَلَسٍ فَرَكِبَ نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَرَكِبَ أَبُو طَلْحَةَ وَأَنَا رَدِيفُ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ فَأَجْرَى نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي زُقَاقِ خَيْبَرَ وَإِنَّ رُكْبَتِي لَتَمَسُّ فَخِذَ نَبِيِّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَانْحَسَرَ الإِزَارُ عَنْ فَخِذِ نَبِيِّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَإِنِّي لأَرَى بَيَاضَ فَخِذِ نَبِيِّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَلَمَّا دَخَلَ الْقَرْيَةَ قَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ خَرِبَتْ خَيْبَرُ إِنَّا إِذَا نَزَلْنَا بِسَاحَةِ قَوْمٍ فَسَاءَ صَبَاحُ الْمُنْذَرِينَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَهَا ثَلاَثَ مَرَّاتٍ قَالَ وَقَدْ خَرَجَ الْقَوْمُ إِلَى أَعْمَالِهِمْ فَقَالُوا مُحَمَّدٌ وَاللَّهِ ‏.‏ قَالَ عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ وَقَالَ بَعْضُ أَصْحَابِنَا مُحَمَّدٌ وَالْخَمِيسُ ‏.‏ قَالَ وَأَصَبْنَاهَا عَنْوَةً وَجُمِعَ السَّبْىُ فَجَاءَهُ دِحْيَةُ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَعْطِنِي جَارِيَةً مِنَ السَّبْىِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ اذْهَبْ فَخُذْ جَارِيَةً ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَأَخَذَ صَفِيَّةَ بِنْتَ حُيَىٍّ فَجَاءَ رَجُلٌ إِلَى نَبِيِّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ يَا نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ أَعْطَيْتَ دِحْيَةَ صَفِيَّةَ بِنْتَ حُيَىٍّ سَيِّدِ قُرَيْظَةَ وَالنَّضِيرِ مَا تَصْلُحُ إِلاَّ لَكَ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ ادْعُوهُ بِهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَجَاءَ بِهَا فَلَمَّا نَظَرَ إِلَيْهَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ خُذْ جَارِيَةً مِنَ السَّبْىِ غَيْرَهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ وَأَعْتَقَهَا وَتَزَوَّجَهَا ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لَهُ ثَابِتٌ يَا أَبَا حَمْزَةَ مَا أَصْدَقَهَا قَالَ نَفْسَهَا أَعْتَقَهَا وَتَزَوَّجَهَا حَتَّى إِذَا كَانَ بِالطَّرِيقِ جَهَّزَتْهَا لَهُ أُمُّ سُلَيْمٍ فَأَهْدَتْهَا لَهُ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ فَأَصْبَحَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَرُوسًا فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَنْ كَانَ عِنْدَهُ شَىْءٌ فَلْيَجِئْ بِهِ ‏"‏ قَالَ وَبَسَطَ نِطَعًا قَالَ فَجَعَلَ الرَّجُلُ يَجِيءُ بِالأَقِطِ وَجَعَلَ الرَّجُلُ يَجِيءُ بِالتَّمْرِ وَجَعَلَ الرَّجُلُ يَجِيءُ بِالسَّمْنِ فَحَاسُوا حَيْسًا ‏.‏ فَكَانَتْ وَلِيمَةَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
translation_en: Zuhayr ibn Harb narrated to me. Ismail, meaning Ibn Ulayyah, narrated to us, from Abd al-Aziz, from Anas. He said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) fought at Khaybar. He said: We prayed the dawn prayer there before it was light. The Prophet of Allah (peace be upon him) mounted, Abu Talhah mounted, and I rode behind Abu Talhah. The Prophet of Allah (peace be upon him) urged his mount through the narrow lanes of Khaybar, and my knee touched the thigh of the Prophet of Allah (peace be upon him). His waist wrapper slipped from his thigh, and I could see the whiteness of the thigh of the Prophet of Allah (peace be upon him). When he entered the settlement, he said: Allah is greatest! Khaybar is destroyed. When we descend in the courtyard of a people, evil is the morning of those who were warned. He said this three times. The people had already gone out to their work, and they said: Muhammad, by Allah! Abd al-Aziz said: Some of our companions said: Muhammad and the army. He said: We conquered it by force, and the captives were gathered. Dihyah came and said: Messenger of Allah, give me a girl from the captives. He said: Go and take a girl. He took Safiyyah, daughter of Huyayy. A man came to the Prophet of Allah (peace be upon him) and said: Messenger of Allah, you gave Dihyah Safiyyah, daughter of Huyayy, the chief of Qurayzah and al-Nadir. She is suitable only for you. He said: Call him with her. When he brought her and the Prophet (peace be upon him) saw her, he said: Take another girl from the captives. He then freed her and married her. Thabit said: Abu Hamzah, what was her bridal gift? He said: Her own freedom: he freed her and married her. When they were on the road, Umm Sulaym prepared her for him and presented her to him at night. In the morning the Prophet (peace be upon him) was a bridegroom. He said: Whoever has anything should bring it. He spread out a leather mat. One man brought dried curds, another brought dates, and another brought clarified butter. They mixed it into a dish of hais, and that was the wedding feast of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him).
translation_de: Zuhayr ibn Harb überlieferte mir. Ismail, meaning Ibn Ulayyah, überlieferte uns, from Abd al-Aziz, from Anas. He sagte: Der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) kämpfte at Khaybar. He sagte: We prayed the Morgengebet there before it was light. The Prophet of Allah (peace be upon him) bestieg sein Reittier, Abu Talhah bestieg sein Reittier, and I rode behind Abu Talhah. The Prophet of Allah (peace be upon him) urged his mount through the narrow lanes of Khaybar, and my knee touched the Oberschenkel of der Prophet Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm). His waist wrapper slipped from his Oberschenkel, and I could see the whiteness of the Oberschenkel of der Prophet Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm). When he entered the Siedlung, he sagte: Allah ist größer! Khaybar is destroyed. When we descend in the courtyard of a people, evil is the Morgen of those who were warned. He said this three times. The people had already gone out to their work, and they sagte: Muhammad, by Allah! Abd al-Aziz sagte: Some of our companions sagte: Muhammad and the army. He sagte: We conquered it by force, and the Gefangenen were gathered. Dihyah came and sagte: Messenger of Allah, give me a girl from the Gefangenen. He sagte: Go and take a girl. He took Safiyyah, daughter of Huyayy. A man came to der Prophet Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) and sagte: Messenger of Allah, you gave Dihyah Safiyyah, daughter of Huyayy, the chief of Qurayzah and al-Nadir. She is suitable only for you. He sagte: Call him with her. When he brought her and der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm) saw her, he sagte: Take another girl from the Gefangenen. He then befreite sie and heiratete sie. Thabit sagte: Abu Hamzah, what was her Brautgabe? He sagte: Her own Freiheit: he befreite sie and heiratete sie. When they were on the Weg, Umm Sulaym prepared her for him and presented her to him at Nacht. In the Morgen der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm) was a Bräutigam. He sagte: Whoever has anything should bring it. He spread out a leather mat. One man brought getrockneten Quark, another brought Datteln, and another brought geklärte Butter. They mixed it into a dish of hais, and that was the Hochzeitsmahl of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him). Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.
